title: Trace a Job From Submission to Last Task
description:
**SITUATION:**

The standalone cluster on `ds-spark-01`, `ds-spark-02`, and `ds-spark-03` is warmed up. Open the Master UI: you should see **2 ALIVE** workers. Your job is to run work on that healthy cluster and learn how a Spark application shows up across the screens you will live in later.

Until now you have mostly looked at **daemons**. The next layer is an **application**: you `spark-submit` from the shell, a **driver** starts there (client mode), the Master lists a new `app-…` id, and the **Application UI** is where Jobs, Stages, and Tasks become concrete.

You will submit **three** small jobs with the same client shape. What changes is the **DAG**: Part 1 is narrow transforms only (no shuffle), Part 2 adds **one** shuffle, Part 3 has **multiple** shuffles. Job details and submit parameters are in the **Guide**.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Open the **Master UI** and confirm both Workers are **ALIVE** (**2 ALIVE**).
2. **Part 1:** submit `orders-narrow` in **client** mode; capture Investigation while it runs.
3. **Part 2:** submit `orders-by-store` the same way; capture Investigation while it runs.
4. **Part 3:** submit `store-rollup-join`; capture stages and one task → Worker host.
5. Fill the **Investigation** tab in story order, then Submit.

hints: Part 3: /opt/spark/lab/jobs/store_rollup_join.py — expect ≥3 stages; trace one task to a Worker host.
Use --deploy-mode client from the shell. Executor shape: --executor-memory 512m --conf spark.executor.memoryOverhead=128m.
The three parts must be different application ids on this Master.
Fill the Investigation tab — missing answers fail on Submit.

problemStatement.guide:
# Trace a job — three DAG shapes

Same submit shape every time (client mode from the shell). What changes is the **DAG**: no shuffle, one shuffle, then several.

Shared submit flags:

```bash
spark-submit \
  --master "$SPARK_MASTER_URL" \
  --deploy-mode client \
  --total-executor-cores 2 \
  --executor-memory 512m \
  --conf spark.executor.memoryOverhead=128m \
  --name <app-name> \
  /opt/spark/lab/jobs/<script>.py
```

---

## Part 1 — `orders-narrow` (transforms only → **0** shuffles)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Script** | `/opt/spark/lab/jobs/orders_narrow.py` |
| **App name** | `orders-narrow` |
| **Work** | Read orders (explicit schema) → `filter` / `select` → **write** CSV |
| **DAG** | **One** stage — narrow transforms + write, **no** Shuffle Read/Write |
| **Hold** | ~**75s** |

```bash
spark-submit \
  --master "$SPARK_MASTER_URL" \
  --deploy-mode client \
  --name orders-narrow \
  --total-executor-cores 2 \
  --executor-memory 512m \
  --conf spark.executor.memoryOverhead=128m \
  /opt/spark/lab/jobs/orders_narrow.py
```

While it holds: Master UI → `app-…` id. Application UI → Jobs → Stages — **1** stage, empty Shuffle columns.

---

## Part 2 — `orders-by-store` (one action, **one** shuffle)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Script** | `/opt/spark/lab/jobs/orders_by_store.py` |
| **App name** | `orders-by-store` |
| **Work** | `groupBy("store_id").sum("amount")` → `collect` |
| **DAG** | **Two** stages — partial aggregate, **one** shuffle, final aggregate |
| **Hold** | ~**90s** |

```bash
spark-submit \
  --master "$SPARK_MASTER_URL" \
  --deploy-mode client \
  --name orders-by-store \
  --total-executor-cores 2 \
  --executor-memory 512m \
  --conf spark.executor.memoryOverhead=128m \
  /opt/spark/lab/jobs/orders_by_store.py
```

While it holds: new `app-…`. Stages — **2** stages; one has Shuffle Write, the next Shuffle Read.

---

## Part 3 — `store-rollup-join` (**multiple** shuffles)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Script** | `/opt/spark/lab/jobs/store_rollup_join.py` |
| **App name** | `store-rollup-join` |
| **Work** | Join orders ↔ stores → `groupBy("region").sum("amount")` → `collect` |
| **DAG** | **≥ 3** stages — join shuffle **and** aggregate shuffle |
| **Hold** | ~**3 minutes** |

```bash
spark-submit \
  --master "$SPARK_MASTER_URL" \
  --deploy-mode client \
  --name store-rollup-join \
  --total-executor-cores 2 \
  --executor-memory 512m \
  --conf spark.executor.memoryOverhead=128m \
  /opt/spark/lab/jobs/store_rollup_join.py
```

While it holds:

1. New `app-…` (third id).
2. Stages — more than Part 2; more than one shuffle boundary.
3. Open a stage → one **task** → record task id, executor id, Worker host (`ds-spark-02` or `ds-spark-03`).

---

## Investigation

Fill Parts 1 → 2 → 3, then the lesson page. Submit when every field is filled.

grade.submitMessage: This may take a bit — checking all three DAG traces.
